message.jaymoskingdoms.ash_rot.unknown: The rot has not come to your hands yet.
message.jaymoskingdoms.ash_rot.no_foe: Nothing there for the rot to take.
message.jaymoskingdoms.ash_rot.no_wall: No wall close enough to rot through.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.hush_ward.de: The Lantern Warden's hush round you for half a minute: blows and shots stop just short of you, a point of stamina for each point of harm. Blasts get through.
stat.jaymoskingdoms.power.desc: For those with a power: its own moves hit harder, reach further where they are aimed, and what they lay on others lasts longer.
stat.jaymoskingdoms.power.now: +%s%% harm from your power's moves, +%s%% reach when aimed, +%s%% longer on others
gui.jaymoskingdoms.stats.blocked.powerle: Only someone with a power can raise this.
message.jaymoskingdoms.combat_mode.on: Combat mode: in stance, 1-5 fire your belt's forms
message.jaymoskingdoms.combat_mode.off: Combat mode off: 1-5 pick hotbar slots again
message.jaymoskingdoms.cordon.summons_re: The summons unfolds into a map. The court is marked on it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.cordon.summons_bl: The summons is blank here. Its court is in the Overworld.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.cordon.arrive.0: What woke in you was never yours to keep.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.cordon.arrive.1: The gift is forbidden. Kneel, and it ends quietly.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.cordon.arrive.2: There. The one who shines. Take them.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.cordon.rally: Bind them! The Arbiter will judge what's left.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.cordon.learned.sho: Your shots are known to me.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.cordon.learned.blu: Your fists are known to me.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.cordon.learned.bla: Your blade is known to me.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.cordon.learned.mag: That gift of yours is known to me.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.cordon.learned.bea: Your beasts are known to me.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.cordon.overload: Too much... too much to hold!
stranger.jaymoskingdoms.name: %s, %s of %s
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stranger.call.0: You carry it too. I can feel it from here. Show me.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stranger.call.1: I've walked a long way to find someone like you. Defend yourself!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stranger.call.2: They say yours is strong. Let's see whose is stronger.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stranger.call.3: No sense hiding it. Come on, then!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stranger.yield.0: Enough! Enough. You've the better of it.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stranger.yield.1: I yield. I've more road to walk yet.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stranger.yield.2: Well fought. I'll be stronger when we meet again.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stranger.won.1: Find me when you've grown into it.
